_comment: The models Socrates is meant to run on, newest first, per provider and role (fast: the small checks, such as the safety judgement, the title and the summary; reply: the text the user reads). An entry with an 'approved' date has passed the live batteries on it (BUILD_PLAN M4); an entry without one is listed but not measured yet. The table is a preference, not a requirement: a model that is listed and available wins; when none is, the newest model of the right family is taken from the provider's own list and the result is marked untested, so a retired or new model never stops the program.

fast.notes: the small checks; not yet measured on the safety battery

reply.notes: used for the first live character runs of 2026-10-23; the quality battery is still to be run
